contrary_evidence: BLS payroll growth of 165,000 and unemployment of 4.1% show resilience in hiring but do not establish a future inflation path.
Quarterly nonfarm productivity rose 3.6% annualised while unit labour costs fell 0.7%; four-quarter unit labour costs still rose 2.4%.
China's manufacturing PMI was 49.3, but large manufacturers remained at 50.2 and the survey is not a physical output measure.
The IIF outflow estimate is a monthly non-resident portfolio-flow measure, not total capital flight or a complete balance-of-payments account.
The FAO index fell month on month but remained above its year-earlier level; food commodity indices are not household retail or nutrition measures.
limitations: No complete comparable panel of small-market credit spreads or daily foreign-exchange flows was verified by the cutoff.
FRED OAS covers US dollar-denominated below-investment-grade corporate bonds, not global credit costs.
IIF's US$33.8bn estimate is a monthly non-resident portfolio-flow measure, not total capital flight or FDI.
The NBS PMI is a diffusion survey and does not establish physical output, customs flows or company profitability.
The report-specific system-registry reconciliation has not been run; it is required before public promotion.
